div.div: 2 وبّخهُ , inf. n. تَوْبِيخٌ, He reproved him, or lamed him, (L, Msb, K,) بِسُوْءِ فِعْلِهِ for his evil action or conduct: (L:) reproved or blamed him, or did so severely, or with the utmost severity; and threatened him: (S, L, K:) reproached or upbraided him. (El-Fárábee, Msb.) ابّخهُ is a dial. form of the same: (IAar:) or its hemzeh is a substitute for the و. (ISd.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
